brief: The canvas displays a dark, atmospheric background upon which glowing cyan and green lines continuously sweep outward from a central point. These lines form concentric rings and rapidly moving arcs, simulating the motion of a radar sweep. Scattered across the field are soft, pulsating dots that appear at random intervals and pulse in brightness before fading away. The entire composition is defined by cyclical, radial movement, giving the illusion of active detection and scanning across the plane.
statement: This sketch creates an atmospheric radar visualization with a dark background and glowing cyan-green lines. Concentric rings slowly rotate from the center while a bright sweep line rapidly rotates outward, simulating active scanning motion. Random pulsating dots appear across the field and fade away, representing detected objects. The composition uses cyclical radial movement to create an illusion of continuous detection and surveillance, with the entire scene evolving autonomously without any user input required.
